title: Special Executive Programme In Project Management
description: Gain essential project management skills to effectively initiate, execute, and control projects, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction and quality outcomes.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme provides a comprehensive foundation in project management, from feasibility studies to implementation strategies. Participants will learn stakeholder engagement, project quality management, and effective communication techniques. Explore tools like PERT and Gantt charts while mastering MS Project for planning and resource allocation.
courseDetails: The course covers critical aspects of project initiation, including cost-benefit analysis and stakeholder relationship management. Students will delve into project quality management, estimation techniques, and team dynamics. Additionally, learn about project control strategies, performance management, and the capability model for project maturity.
